description.value: Your mark, and everything the duel has accumulated against it, persists between encounters and through unconsciousness — theirs or yours. Nobody has ever escaped a Second by leaving the room.

cinderfall.incomplete: The mark and its accumulated duel effects persist across encounters and through unconsciousness. No rule element persists a target identity/relationship across separate encounters -- the mark predicate is confirmed unfireable even within a single encounter, let alone across a rest boundary.
